Change versus baseline value

Source: R/plot-visits.R
plot_delta_vs_baseline.Rd

Shows regression to the mean and floor / ceiling effects: change between two visits against the first-visit value, LOESS smooth with its 95% band and the Spearman correlation between baseline and change.

Usage

plot_delta_vs_baseline(
  data,
  roots,
  from = "V0",
  to = "V3",
  labels = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  ncol = 3,
  base_size = 10
)

Arguments

data

Wide format.

roots

Root names (one panel each).

from, to

Visit suffixes.

labels

Optional named vector of labels.

group

Optional colour variable.

palette

Colours of the groups.

ncol

Number of columns of panels.

base_size

Base font size.

Value

A patchwork, or NULL when no root has at least 10 complete pairs.

Examples

plot_delta_vs_baseline(cohort_sim, c("NFL", "MOCA"), group = GROUP)
